items.title: fix(ui): clear parent unread dot left by hidden subagent runs (#165792)
items.summary: fix(ui): clear parent unread dot left by hidden subagent runs (#165792) Hidden subagent runs (which have no sidebar row since #151470) could leave a parent session, or Home, showing an unread dot forever. Opening the parent and Mark as read only acknowledged the parent row, and an ordinary parent's menu offered Mark as unread instead of Mark as read. Opening a parent or Home now also acknowledges its hidden runs. The session menu sees hidden-run unread, so Mark as read is offered and clears it. Proof: a real built Gateway and Chromium, with a scripted `sessions_spawn` hidden run that finishes unread. On main the dot stays after opening the parent, and the menu offers only Mark as unread. With this change, opening the parent or Home clears it, the menu offers Mark as read, and choosing it clears the dot. New hidden activity brings the dot back, and visible-child and unrelated session unread markers are unaffected. The regression tests fail on base and pass here. Before and after screenshots are in the PR. Related: #165709 Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: fix(heartbeat): report a background command's result when its output …
items.summary: fix(heartbeat): report a background command's result when its output went to a file (#166123) A successful background command whose output went elsewhere (e.g. redirected to a file) now wakes the conversation with "Exec completed (, code 0) without captured stdout/stderr." through the normal continuation prompt, instead of "no command output was found. Reply NO_REPLY only", so the agent can finish its own follow-up (read the file, report). Routine completions still stay silent. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: 日經新聞員工M365帳號遭到入侵，被用於發布約9,000封釣魚信
items.summary: 日本大型媒體日本經濟新聞社（日經新聞）於10月4日，公布兩起涉及員工雲端服務帳號遭竊的資安事故。其中一起是員工的Microsoft 365帳號遭到攻擊，被用於發送約9,000封欺騙性的電子郵件。本地事故可能曝露收件人姓名、電子郵件地址，以及部分電子郵件內容，日經新聞已更改被盜帳號的密碼，向當地資料保護機關通報，並著手調查資料外洩影響範圍與人數。日經透露這件事故出現在9月30日，攻擊者濫用此M365帳號發送帶有連結的釣魚信，試圖將收信人導向惡意網站，目標涵蓋先前曾與該公司員工接觸過的人士。

items.title: JetBrains縮減KMP的Swift開發工具支援，Swift程式碼改由Xcode等工具處理
items.summary: JetBrains宣布，從IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3與Android Studio Rabbit 2 | 2026.2.2開始，Kotlin Multiplatform（KMP）外掛將停止提供Swift程式碼編輯功能，包括語法上色、檔案導覽，以及在Swift與Kotlin程式碼之間直接跳轉。不過，開發者仍可執行iOS應用程式，也能在iOS裝置上除錯Kotlin程式碼。
